Your signal playbook

All three checks must agree. Otherwise, wait.

BUYEMA 9 above EMA 21, close above EMA 21, RSI between 50 and 70.
SELL / EXITEMA 9 below EMA 21, close below EMA 21, RSI between 30 and 50.
WAITMixed conditions, overextended momentum, missing or stale data.

Research tool. These rules have not been validated as a profitable strategy. Confirm your own entry and exit before trading.
